#!/bin/bash
# Check that MockSetupHelper.SetupGameOptionsManagerMock() is called in BakaryRoleTests constructor
# This fixes a NullReferenceException when the test tries to access game options

TEST_FILE="ExtremeRoles.UnitTest/Roles/Solo/Crewmate/Bakary/BakaryRoleTests.cs"

if [ ! -f "$TEST_FILE" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: Test file not found at $TEST_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

# Check that SetupGameOptionsManagerMock is called in the constructor
if grep -q 'MockSetupHelper\.SetupGameOptionsManagerMock()' "$TEST_FILE"; then
    echo "PASS: MockSetupHelper.SetupGameOptionsManagerMock() call found in BakaryRoleTests"
    exit 0
else
    echo "FAIL: MockSetupHelper.SetupGameOptionsManagerMock() NOT found in BakaryRoleTests constructor"
    echo "The NullReferenceException fix requires this line to be present."
    exit 1
fi
